name: HEALTHBANE vs MedDefense - Attack Reconstruction Final (4x05)
description: Final technique layer for the HEALTHBANE campaign against MedDefense Health Systems, 2026-04-14 to 2026-05-15 (containment). Coverage: 29/29 modeled techniques observed; 28/29 CONFIRMED (96.6%); T1078 PROBABLE (credentials harvested, use unverified - Task 0 Q7). Three beyond-model confirmations (T1105, T1140, T1583.001) are included but excluded from the modeled-coverage fraction. Colors indicate attack stage: Stage 1 Initial Access (red), Stage 2 C2/Infrastructure (blue), Stage 3 Malware Deployment (orange), Stage 4 Lateral Movement/Data Staging (purple), Cross-Stage (green), PROBABLE/unverified-use (grey). Greyed-out (disabled) entries are legacy 4x04 mappings not independently confirmed by the reconstruction - see per-technique comments. ERRATUM: T1105 was omitted from the Task 9 print inventory in error; evidence (4x01 PCAP download of svchost_update.exe, 4x03 hash match) confirms it and it is restored here. Per-technique comment format: Stage | Confidence | First identified | Evidence sources | Notes.
